RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 50

An all-male panel increases the risk of affinity bias, particularly when subjective criteria like "client relationships" override significant differences in experience (15 versus 8 years) and project leadership. However, group-head roles frequently prioritize commercial networking and business development over technical seniority, so gender may not have been the deciding factor.

Whether to raise it depends on your goals. Explicitly alleging bias now may trigger organizational defensiveness and stall dialogue. Instead, follow up firmly on your written feedback request, focusing on objective scoring and role criteria. If the explanation is evasive, unsubstantiated, or fails to materialize, the panel’s composition becomes valuable supporting context for a formal HR grievance or legal consultation.
